review_type: bounded prior-art exclusion audit, not a universal originality proof

corpus_scope.incoming_content: README retirement/index ledger, including all 41 named packets and summaries of older K215 work
corpus_scope.reviewed: All principal report heading inventories and packet-level overview coverage; latest cumulative exclusion taxonomies; relevant proposal sections and technical notes; candidate-specific conceptual and exact-name searches of prose and proposal artifacts. Historical unchanged source snapshots were distinguished from actual proposals.
corpus_scope.not_claimed: No line-by-line semantic review of every historical source snapshot, compiler log, or transitively linked older report.

decision_standard: Treat every prior mechanism as applied, including deferred, optional, rejected-as-repeat, and future-work variants.
A local application of an already proposed generic contract is not new merely because its declaration name is absent from a report.
An exact stronger contract may qualify when the older promised APIs do not already discharge that obligation.
Do not claim old source reductions again; actual-pin measurements and hypothetical post-adoption residual benefit are separate.

Shares direct/native graph-builder control flow while retaining separate realizers and costs; import organization by itself is not a shorter proof.
A shared rule-schedule syntax has numeric and supplied-program interpretations, without this Computability dependency inversion.

retained_proposals.residual_contribution: Split raw enumerator semantics below the direct supplied program, then use program.val.primrec and the realization equality as the sole proof of haltingTest_natPrimrec. not_claimed: No new fun_prop rules, PR recursor congruence, program optimizer, or shared graph-builder template.
No changed executable supplied program, witness cost, or code representation.
No complete compilation of the proposed three-file split; the independent receipt checks a static project import graph and exact source-byte preservation only.
No runtime speedup or precise net source saving against an unspecified hypothetical checkout containing every earlier alternative.
retained_proposals.counterfactual_boundary: The actual-pin line reduction must be reported separately from the extra benefit after packet i; its registration and client savings cannot be reclaimed.
retained_proposals.remaining_gate: Compile the exact split and affected public clients with original imports and the pinned toolchain; check private-instance and moved-definition elaboration.

retained_proposals.residual_contribution: The compatibility production patch removes row 0 and the unnecessarily strong intermediate bounds while still using hbeta.le. not_claimed: The q,L,N source-row semantic interface, repeated raw-row decoding, and cast cleanup were already proposed in packet b.
No novelty claimed for generic integer positivity, nlinarith, divisibility, or helper extraction.

No complete production import-closure rebuild, and no claim that 8 actual-pin lines are 8 additional lines after every older proposal.

retained_proposals.title: Recover beta positivity from a positive zero and remove the guard from source equivalences

targets.role: Guarded positive-zero equivalence and integer existence equivalence

closest_prior.role: Earlier source-register decoding: q=1+J*beta, L=q^2-1, N=q*(1+L)=q^3, X=q*w; names source_Y_ge_two explicitly.
Named positivity projections and PortBounds.beta_pos from already supplied bounds.
Explicit beta_pos suggestion derives it from beta_min, not from zero equations.
Source-construction positivity from a selected digit removes marking; does not recover beta sign or eliminate the source-zero-equivalence guard.

retained_proposals.residual_contribution: Old and gap positive zeros satisfy L=q^2-1 with q=1+beta*J, and respectively N=q*(1+L) or Ngap=q*L. Positive coordinates force q>1 and beta>0. Each direction of the equivalence recovers its required guard from the input solution, so the zero-set equivalence can be stated for every port tuple.
not_claimed: No new generic equivalence transport or generic guard-discharge construction.
No new q,L,N row decoding interface.
No unconditional positivity of toOld on arbitrary positive tuples: zero equations are essential to recovering the guard.
No change to independently required completeness/calibration PortBox assumptions.
No independent-family count beyond B1, no present net source reduction when helpers and compatibility wrappers add lines, and no complete production compile claim.
retained_proposals.counterfactual_boundary: Assume prior semantic equations and witness transport are available; the residual result is endogenous beta-sign recovery and the resulting unguarded endpoint contract.
retained_proposals.remaining_gate: Compile the complete GapSource66 adapter and downstream consumers; count helper and compatibility-wrapper costs explicitly.
